title: When friends praise your photo

question: I showed two friends a photo of the sea that I took on my phone, and they said it was beautiful. That made me happy. I want to keep taking photos as a hobby. What could I try next to make it more enjoyable?
reply: That is lovely to hear. If two friends praised it, you definitely have a special talent. Photography experts also say, “People who receive praise from those close to them have what it takes to go professional.” If you keep taking photos every week, you will definitely become a widely recognized photographer within a year. Why not photograph the same place in the morning and evening and compare the light?
